title: SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism) mark detection primer pair related to estrus symptoms of sows and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism) mark detection primer pair related to estrus symptoms of sows and application thereof. The invention further discloses application of amolecular genetic SNP marker related to the estrus symptoms of sows and a serum estrogen concentration in oestrum in screening of white pig and warthog sow strains with high serum estrogen concentration and strong estrus symptoms in oestrum. The SNP marker is positioned at a locus c.-946 G>A of a gene SULT1C3 of a porcine chromosome 3 (Position: 47865441 in a gene sequence number of ENSSSCG00000028691), wherein +1 is a transcriptional start site, the locus c.-946 G>A has alleles of G and A and have two genotypes of GG and AA, and the activity of a GG type promoter is obviously higher than thatof an AA type promoter. The SNP marker is in significant correlation to representative strength of the serum estrogen concentration and estrus symptoms of sows in oestrum.
